pr_body:
Added injections of `OAuth2TokenValidator<Jwt>` beans to `ReactiveOAuth2ResourceServerJwkConfiguration`and `OAuth2ResourceServerJwtConfiguration` to provide an easy way to add custom validations and still use auto-configuration (#35783)

Closes gh-35783
pr_title: Support custom token validators for OAuth2 Resource Server auto-configuration
pr_comment: Rebased to the main branch since some tests unrelated to the PR failed in the previous run https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/actions/runs/5258769234/jobs/9667349868?pr=35874
Thanks for the PR, @romangr. I've left a few comments for your consideration when you have a minute.
@romangr, thanks very much for making your first contribution to Spring Boot.

review_comment: If there are no audiences and no custom validators, we should return the `defaultValidator` rather than creating a `DelegatingOAuth2TokenValidator` with a single delegate.

I added a check for number of validators in the list to avoid duplication of the `CollectionUtils.isEmpty(audiences)` check. I think this way it will be easier to add new predefined validators like the one for audiences if needed.
